comment: Fueling constants for the fuel/drop-bag cards + planner column, written by the race-intake planner (scripts/race-plan.mjs) and free to edit. Demand-driven fills: base = tailwind_flasks of mix; when a leg's fluid shortfall exceeds preload_over_flask_ml, ONE extra flask takes mix, further spares (up to spare_flasks total) take plain water; smaller shortfalls are drunk at the aid before leaving. bloks_frac = share of a phase's carried units taken as Clif Bloks. drop_bag_gear = non-food items per bag ('Start' = the vest).

phases.supplement: gels lead; chews while chewing is still easy — get the calories in before the 12,438 ft high point
gels + Tailwind; load the vest at Calico #6 for the 12 mi / +3,278 ft carry to Burnett #7
gels + hot broth/coke at aid; warm liquid calories through the night — chewing fails first at 10,000 ft
whatever stays down — coke, broth, Tailwind sipped continuously; do not let the rate hit zero on the last two climbs

Start: sunscreen + sun cap/hoody (above treeline from mile 0)
waterproof hard shell, gloves, hat/buff (required gear)
1.5 L capacity: 2× 600 ml flasks + spare 500 ml soft flask
water filter (recommended for both long carries)
EMT #2: fuel for the 16.3 mi carry to Middle of Nowhere #4 — only backcountry aid in between
Tailwind refill scoops + top off the third flask
sunscreen + lip balm reapply before the 12,438 ft high point
light wind shell if the morning build looks stormy
Middle of Nowhere #4: main headlamp + spare battery (last bag before dark at cutoff pace)
backup light — two sources are required gear
Cross Mountain #5: insulated midlayer/puffy — last bag before 25.5 mi of night to Ryman Creek #8
beanie + warm gloves for the coldest hours
dry shirt + second spare headlamp battery
full night fuel load, incl. the 12 mi / +3,278 ft Calico→Burnett carry
pacer's bib-pickup reminder; first crew access
Ryman Creek #8: fresh socks + second shoes + blister kit (creek crossings and the lowest, wettest miles are behind you)
sunscreen and sun hat for day two
shed night layers here — bag the puffy and beanie
day-two fuel reset + clean flasks before the +2,663 ft to Corral #9
Elbert Creek #11: small backup headlamp with fresh batteries — a slow finish reaches a second dusk before the 20:00 cutoff
light wind shell for the last 7.9 mi

caffeine_comment: Caffeinated-gel schedule. Doses are placed from nightfall to tail_h before the projected finish, never tighter than min_spacing_h, and snapped to aid stations where one is close — so the schedule moves with the goal time. Body mass comes from config/profile.json physiology, not from here. Set gels to 0 to plan the race caffeine-free.
